{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Exclude non-converted completed orders (likely internal test orders)
# Since non-converted completed orders have zero revenue, and converted ones have positive revenue,
# we assume that only converted completed orders are real sales.
final_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['converted'] == 1]

# Calculate total revenue
total_revenue = final_orders['revenue'].sum()

# Print the result
total_revenue"}
